messages.content: The inspected subject.mjs already handles: UTF-16 units, interior end moved backward (end--), nonempty-progress rejection, safe-integer ranges, empty slice at EOF, and return fields. The missing contract item is rejecting an interior start (offset landing inside a surrogate pair). I'll add that check using the same pair test, preserving everything else byte-for-byte.
messages.reasoning_content: Current subject.mjs has a bug: it doesn't reject interior start. Add need(!splitPair(offset)...) — check interior start: position where offset>0 and offset<length and text[offset] is low surrogate and text[offset-1] is high surrogate. Use splitPair(offset) definition but splitPair checks position as an end; for a start interior, position is start and pair spans [position-1,position]. splitPair(position) tests exactly text[position-1] high and text[position] low — same condition for interior start. So need(!splitPair(offset),'inspection-range-splits-unicode')? contract says reject interior start. Also end move backward already done via end--. Add check.
